svg.title: How an onmodel check works
svg.desc: A product photo, a pose photo and a prompt go into your image engine. The result photo, with the product photo, goes through onmodel check: a locator crops the product, a reviewer answers nine questions, a text rule compares printed words, and code computes the scorecard.
